name: Biological Sciences PhD
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.
summary: Research PhD at the University of Nebraska–Lincoln.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall application
publishedDeadlines.note: No year stated; confirm the intended admission cycle.

applicationFee.note: Not currently enrolled: $50; currently enrolled UNL students: $25. Central office does not issue waivers, but departments may cover fees; contact program before payment. No citizenship restriction stated on this route; international applicants should confirm eligibility. Biology asks other applicants to request consideration by November 15; BTAA FreeApp has separate US-citizen/permanent-resident criteria.

english.note: Central current TOEFL minimum 4 after January 21, 2026; no department-specific new-scale equivalent verified. English-medium accredited bachelor’s or advanced degree exempts testing. Scores valid two years; central ESL 887 placement may still apply based on scores.

documents: Unofficial transcripts/mark sheets from all institutions, plus international degree certificates/diplomas and certified English translations
Identify up to 4 faculty sharing research interests
requirements.note: Official records required after admission. F/J visa applicants must provide financial information. Central profile says new entry once yearly in August. Bachelor’s or equivalent and GPA 3.0 in department guidelines.

funding.note: First-year TA/RA appointments generally available, competitive; published undated academic-year stipend $23, 040 with tuition remission and health benefits. Up to 12 credits tuition waiver/semester. International teaching assistants must attend International Teaching Assistant Institute. No all-admitted guarantee.
